issue_types.name: bug
issue_types.description: Something is broken in production — P0/P1 only

issue_types.name: hardening
issue_types.description: Defensive improvement, tech debt, missing validation, weak patterns

priorities.name: P0
priorities.description: Production incident or imminent security exploit — drop everything

priorities.name: P1
priorities.description: Every other bug; or non-bug blocking another team's delivery

priorities.name: P2
priorities.description: Important non-bug; complete this sprint or cycle

priorities.name: P3
priorities.description: Lower priority; schedule when capacity allows

priorities.name: P4
priorities.description: Nice to have; add to backlog

concerns.name: security
concerns.description: Has a security dimension — on a bug: fix first

concerns.name: blocked
concerns.description: Waiting on a dependency — add Blocked by #N in body

concerns.name: incident-follow-up
concerns.description: Generated from postmortem; prioritize above normal enhancement work

claim_statuses.name: status:wip
claim_statuses.description: Claimed and in progress — do NOT grab

claim_statuses.name: status:in-review
claim_statuses.description: PR open, awaiting coordinator review and merge
